tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnod sbyin bektse lcam dral gyi drag skul dbang snying nor mdzod bzhugs so// kyai gang sngon bskal par ston pa'i mched gyur tshe/ /lnga bdo'i bstan la bstan dgra sgrol ba dang / /lung rtogs 'dzin kun skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /thugs bskyed dam bca' dran pa'i dus la babs/ /dbang ldan brag dmar 'phyong lding pho brang du/ /zangs ral yab dang khrag ral yum chen las/ /'khrungs pa phyi ru bse sgong lcam sring gnyis/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung dran pa'i dus la babs/ /ma hā de wā e ka dza ṭī yi/ /bka' dang dam tshig nos pa'i gnod sbyin che/ /'jigs rung gdong dmar lha mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /bstan 'gro'i mgon dpung mdzad pa'i dus la babs/ /nyi 'od grags pa zla ba nag po dang / /ga ya dha ra gnyan mar lo chen gnyis/ /sa chen grub thob 'dar phyar la sogs pa/ /bla brgyud bka' dam dran pa'i dus la babs/ /khyad par drin chen bla ma dpal chen dbang / /rta mgrin zhabs kyis bdag la khyed gtad nas/ /ci bcol las kun sgrub par bka' bsgos pa'i/ /'da' dka' dam tshig dran pa'i dus la babs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis mkha' mnyam phan bde'i ched/ /lha khyod sku gsung thugs dang phyi dang gsang / /rten dang mchod gtor gus pas nyer bcas te/ /rgyun du bsten bsgrub gsol zhing mchod bstod kyis/ /dges pa bskyed la brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'dus sde sbyin bdag bcas/ /spyi dang bye brag kun la nyin mtshan du/ /bsrung skyobs bya ra ma g.yel sa mā ya/ /ma rig las nyon 'khrul pas rab bcings pas/ /nga dang nga yir bzung las nad gdon dgra/ /sna tshogs 'khrul ngor shar ba'i lus sems la/ /'phral yun rang gzhan mi 'dod kun ster rnams/ /myur du bsad cing bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo bstan 'dzin yongs la gnod/ /'jig rten ma rungs byed dang khyad par du/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas la/

/sdang zhing gdug pa'i rigs kun gar gnas kyang / /khyed kyi mthu stobs drag shul bsam yas kyis/ /skyobs pa'i lha phrol bsrung ba'i mgon skyabs phyes/ /mi nor rdzas gsum lcags kyu zhags sgrogs dril/ /'bar bas zungs chings sdoms la myos su chug /mgo lus lhu phrol sha khrag srog dbugs bsdus/ /rnam shes bde chen dag pa'i dbyings su sgrol/ /lo dang zla zhag ma 'gyangs da lta nyid/ /mngon spyod drag po'i rtags mtshan myur du ston/ /mi 'bral bdag gi las mdzod gnod sbyin che/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i ru mtshon mkha' dbyings bsgrengs/ /nag phyogs pham nas ming yang mi grags shing / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i legs tshogs kun/ /nam mkha'i nor ltar kun tu gsal bar shog/ //ces gnod sbyin chen po bektse gtso 'khor drag bskul 'di 'dra zhig gyis zhes sa skya pa kun blo'i bu mthu bo dbang gi mtshan can nas bskul ba bzhin 'phar ba'i lo smin drug zla ba'i nyin phyed drag po'i dus la btsan drag po rgyu ba'i yul kha'u sman chab bla ma mnyam med du sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gnod sbyin bektse lcam dral gyi drag bskul dbang snying nor mdzad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
